issues.description: Template initializes number_of_qubits_query_register as a float (0.0) in ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py. QuantumRegister expects an integer number of qubits; using a float will raise a type error or confuse students. The problem statement and solution indicate this should be an integer (two qubits for Exercise 1). This is an unintentional attribute type mismatch in the template that will block students from constructing the circuit until fixed.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template attribute to an integer. For example, set self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2 (int) or at minimum 0 (int) as a placeholder. Preferably set to 2 to match the exercise description (two-qubit Grover).
